tooManyRequests: Too many requests — please wait a moment and try again.
title: Referrals
desc: Earn commission when people you refer sign up, apply, or get hired. Two referral types: Account (signup link, paid as % of platform fee on every milestone of their first contract) and Project (per-job or per-worker link, paid as % of agreed amount).
codeDesc: Share this link anywhere — when someone signs up via it, you'll earn % of the platform fee on their first contract.
accountDesc: People who signed up via your code. You earn a share of the platform fee on every milestone of their first contract.
noSignupsDesc: Share your link to start earning.
jobSharesDesc: Workers you referred to specific jobs. To share, open any job and click "Share for commission".
workerSharesDesc: Workers you recommended to other employers. To share, open a worker profile (employer view) and click "Share with another employer".
incomingDesc: Who referred you, and what they've earned from your contracts.
totalFromActivity: Total earned from your activity to date:
directSignup: You signed up directly — no referrer.
commissionDesc: Referral commissions earned on milestone releases. Held commissions (PENDING) are paid out automatically once you finish Stripe Connect onboarding.
